tips.text: Service-plaza and Tesla sites along this corridor stay unverified unless a network locator page was retrieved. DOE listings for them are in the stop lists.

Branford and West Greenwich searches did not complete on October 14, 2026 because the DOE API hit its rate limit. Sites that only fall in those two searches are not listed yet. The Monday check still runs them.
Waterford Commons lists a CCS connector and a NACS connector on each charger, both at 400 kW, on EA's locator.

arrival: Dedham and Boston city charging are not in this guide. The last stop is Foxborough at I-95 exit 19.
